title: Data is better together: Enabling communities to collectively build better datasets together using Argilla and Hugging Face Spaces
Robo Rendezvous: Robotics Innovators and AI Leaders to Converge at NVIDIA GTC
description: Bringing together pioneers in robotics and AI, NVIDIA GTC will be a state-of-the-art showcase of applied AI for autonomous machines. The conference, running March 18-21 at the San Jose Convention Center and online, boasts a star-studded lineup.
